Donald Duck Advance.name: Disney's Donald Duck Advance
Donald Duck Advance.summary: Donald Duck Advance is a 2D platformer about Donald's quest to rescue his girlfriend from the evil magician Merlock. Players collect magical orbs to unlock the portal to the next level and eat ice cream to manage Donald's anger level.

Donkey Kong Country.name: Donkey Kong Country
Donkey Kong Country.summary: An expanded port of the original Donkey Kong Country for the SNES. Includes extra collectables, remixed/remastered music and sound design, and additional game modes and minigames.

Dragon Ball Z - Collectible Card Game.name: Dragon Ball Z: Collectible Card Game
Dragon Ball Z - Collectible Card Game.summary: Dragon Ball Z: Collectible Card Game is a video game for the Game Boy Advance based on the Dragon Ball Z Collectible Card Game of the Dragon Ball franchise. Its Story Mode covers from the start of the Saiyan Saga to the end of the Cell Games Saga.

Monster Maker 4 - Killer Dice.name: Monster Maker 4: Killer Dice
Monster Maker 4 - Killer Dice.summary: Monster Maker 4: Killer Dice is a Role-Playing game, published by Success, which was released in Japan in 2002.
